datasetStatus.noteEn: List votes follow the result declared in the official notice, by which the seats were given out; its printed total of valid votes, 3,792,472, was officially corrected to 3,792,742 on 12 February 2013. Both versions give exactly the same seats. Candidate lists are as first published; later changes are not shown.
